chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Desi Arnaz's rise with Diosa Costello
summary: Desi Arnaz became popular teaming with Costello in the Broadway show Too Many Girls and its film.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay. In 1940, Valentino's was the big place. Desi Arnaz was getting popularity. How much popularity had he gained at that time and why?
Well, because he teamed up with Diosa Costelo.
Yeah, so he was working at the "Too Many Girls", a show ......

.....on Broadway, and they was the latin part of the thing, like "West Side Story" or whatever, so they made a tremendous team so from there they was working together at La Conga, Diosa Costelo and Desi Arnaz; so he became very popular and the show was very popular and the movie company want Desi Arnaz.
I see. When they made the movie version of "Too Many Girls", they wanted Desi Arnaz for the movie.
She was part of the movie too.
....part of the movie because she was a legitimate performer.
